seo.title: 35 Portfolio Project Ideas for Tokenomics Designers
seo.description: Discover portfolio project ideas for tokenomics designers. From economic models to incentive design, build a portfolio that demonstrates token economics expertise.

content.intro: Tokenomics design requires understanding economics, game theory, and mechanism design. These projects help you demonstrate token economics expertise through analysis and original design work.

sections.heading: Token Analysis Projects
sections.description: Analyze existing tokenomics to demonstrate understanding.

items.title: Token Comparative Analysis
items.description: Compare tokenomics of competing protocols. Analyze strengths and weaknesses.

items.title: Failed Tokenomics Post-mortem
items.description: Analyze why specific token models failed. Terra, Olympus forks, etc.

items.title: Emission Schedule Analysis
items.description: Analyze and compare emission schedules across protocols.

items.title: Governance Token Value Accrual
items.description: Study how different governance tokens accrue (or fail to accrue) value.

items.title: veToken Model Comparison
items.description: Compare implementations of the veToken model across protocols.

items.title: Protocol Revenue Analysis
items.description: Analyze protocol revenue and how it flows to token holders.

sections.heading: Economic Modeling
sections.description: Build models to simulate token economics.

items.title: Token Supply Model
items.description: Build a model simulating token supply over time with emissions and burns.

items.title: Liquidity Mining Simulator
items.description: Model the dynamics of liquidity mining programs.

items.title: Staking Economics Model
items.description: Model staking participation, APY, and network security tradeoffs.

items.title: Token Buyback Model
items.description: Model the effect of buyback programs on token price and supply.

items.title: Inflation vs Deflation Scenarios
items.description: Model different inflation/deflation scenarios and their effects.

items.title: Agent-based Token Simulation
items.description: Build an agent-based model simulating participant behavior.

sections.heading: Original Tokenomics Design
sections.description: Design token models for hypothetical protocols.

items.title: DeFi Protocol Token Design
items.description: Design complete tokenomics for a hypothetical DeFi protocol.

items.title: GameFi Economy Design
items.description: Design a sustainable dual-token economy for a blockchain game.

items.title: DAO Treasury Token
items.description: Design a token model focused on DAO treasury management.

items.title: NFT Collection Tokenomics
items.description: Design tokenomics for an NFT project with utility and governance.

items.title: Layer 2 Token Design
items.description: Design tokenomics for a hypothetical Layer 2 rollup.

items.title: Real World Asset Token
items.description: Design tokenomics for a real-world asset protocol.

items.title: Liquidity Bootstrap Design
items.description: Design a liquidity bootstrapping mechanism for a new protocol.

items.title: Anti-vampire Attack Mechanism
items.description: Design defenses against liquidity vampire attacks.

items.title: Bribing Economics Analysis
items.description: Analyze the economics of governance bribing (Votium, Hidden Hand).

items.title: Points Program Design
items.description: Design a points program that transitions to tokens effectively.

items.title: Referral Incentive Design
items.description: Design referral incentives that grow without gaming.

items.title: Token Analysis Framework
items.description: Create a framework for systematically analyzing any tokenomics.

items.title: Emission Calculator
items.description: Build a calculator for modeling token emissions over time.

items.title: Tokenomics Checklist
items.description: Create a detailed checklist for evaluating tokenomics.

items.title: Token Distribution Dashboard
items.description: Build a Dune dashboard analyzing token distribution patterns.

items.title: Whale Impact Analyzer
items.description: Tool to analyze how whale movements affect token price and liquidity.

items.title: Tokenomics Comparison Report
items.description: Compare tokenomics of similar protocols side-by-side.

items.title: Token Unlock Calendar
items.description: Track and visualize upcoming token unlocks across protocols.

gettingStarted.description: Read whitepapers and docs. Understand what exists.

gettingStarted.title: Learn the failures
gettingStarted.description: Study failed token models. Understand why they failed.

gettingStarted.title: Build economic models
gettingStarted.description: Use spreadsheets or Python to model token dynamics.

gettingStarted.title: Understand game theory
gettingStarted.description: Token design is applied game theory. Study the basics.

gettingStarted.title: Write and share
gettingStarted.description: Publish your analyses. Build a reputation for insight.
